dict.string: Harlo reads heart rate, HRV, sleep, and activity from your Apple Watch (via your iPhone) so it can notice when you are tired or stressed and slow itself down. Data stays on your Mac. You choose per data type. Off by default.
Harlo does not write data to Health. This permission is requested only so macOS shows the same consent dialog if a future feature ever needs it.
Harlo communicates with its own HealthBridge helper on your Mac. No data leaves your machine.
Harlo surfaces gentle coaching prompts as notifications. It will never notify you while you are in DEPLETED state.
